policies.chemi_predict: Retain identifier resolution before report validation; preserve resolved objects as structures, ordered structures/report body fields with retained NULL/FALSE/zero, legacy report field despite schema format, auto_unbox, explicit Accept header, no authentication/retries/hooks, unconditional CLI messages, invalid-report warnings and JSON fallback, empty resolution errors, native report/missing-argument errors and parsed response/error behavior. Retain grouped factory file, original vectorized isTRUE decisions, field order, classes, cache and errors. No schema/method/path keys, transport, hooks or lifecycle badge.

Preserve explicit https://comptox.epa.gov/dashboard-api/ccdapp2/ server, GET related-substances/search/by-dtxsid, auth=FALSE, per-item id queries and existing questioning badge; do not infer a supported production schema key.
